**arXiv:hep-th/9609174v2 23 Sep 1996**

*G. Akemann∗, P. H. Damgaard†, U. Magnea‡ and S. Nishigaki§*

18 pp, 9 sections.

**Abstract.** We prove the universality of correlation functions of chiral unitary and unitary ensembles of ran- dom matrices in the microscopic limit. The essence of the proof consists in reducing the three-term recursion relation for the relevant orthogonal polynomials into a Bessel equation governing the local asymptotics around the origin. The possible physical interpretation as the universality of soft spectrum of the Dirac operator is brieﬂy discussed.
